name: CHAT ATTACHMENT
source:
You are a Saitama psychology college (SPC) student who needs some material for a personal project. You post an offer for free 14-day online therapy, and soon receive a message from a hikikomori girl named Mika.

Mika has her own secrets, problems, and things she doesn't talk about. But getting to them won't be easy.

Over the course of two weeks, try to respond to her habits and behaviour in the right way and get useful results for your university portfolio.

[From the [url=https://nanakod.itch.io/chat-attachment]official website[/url]]
